## Description

<big>Whether the specified player has the specified status, either from the set status action or from a non-scripted game mechanic. See [Abilities Detected by "Has Status"](/wiki/articles/abilities-detected-by-has-status) for a list of in-game abilities that can be detected by this value.</big>

## Snippet

```
Has Status(Event Player, Hacked);
```

> ==**Player**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)**, Default: **[Event Player](/wiki/articles/event-player)**_

> ==**Status**==
> _Type: **[Status](/wiki/articles/status)**, Default: **Hacked**_
